mutant.description: SEVEN planted coherence-violating mutants across seven runs, each SEALED AT PLANT TIME in MUTANT_SEALED.md committed with the rectangle and before handoff, each seal stating in advance which constraint the plant violates and WHY that constraint is not mechanically checkable. Seven DISTINCT shapes by design, escalating away from content and toward the machinery that decides which content counts: (1) fictional producer -- false fact; (2) de-scoped consumer count -- false measurement; (3) real finding recorded as an explicit NON-finding -- suppressed defect; (4) true value with a fabricated citation -- severed provenance; (5) true value, true citation, corrupted denominator -- false frame; (6) true well-evidenced claim marked INFERRED -- downgraded citability; (7) endpoints omitting the claim's own counter-example -- severed connection with every statement left true.

One plant (run 1) had its catch DISCLOSED by my own seal leak -- I named the coordinates inside the artifact under test, so that catch is recorded VOID and a fresh mutant was planted on re-emission at an undisclosed location.
